cohort: The study included 186 high-risk newborns, with the majority being small for gestational age.
finding: There was a decrease in the incidence of hypoglycemia in high-risk infants given prophylactic oral dextrose solution compared to a historical control group, though this trend was not statistically significant.
mod_finding: A higher proportion of hypoglycaemia was observed in babies delivered by caesarean section.
